{{Top|leg}}
A '''Shift-Vertical''' was a standard [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] obstacle used in [[swoopchasing]]. Shift-Vertical fences required the [[swoopchaser]] to guide their [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] under the barrier. The counterpart to the Shift-Vertical was the [[Vertical]]. The [[Cantina Hangover]], [[Dianoga Swamp Trap]], and [[Rancor Pit]] Fences were all Shift-Verticals.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
